search_manifest.lawful_access: Public arXiv Atom API/versioned PDFs, Crossref public metadata, and OpenAlex public metadata; no paywall or authentication bypass.
search_limits: Exact-phrase retrieval had false negatives: it returned zero even though direct TARE was known and inspected separately.
OpenAlex had duplicate TARE identities and zero indexed citations; zero is not proof of absence.
Only returned records and selected primary full texts were inspected.
Patents, private manuscripts, non-indexed proceedings/software, non-English sources, and post-cutoff sources are CANNOT_CHECK.

donor_owned: general block-encoding T-count and ancilla theory
subtraction_summary.reason_novelty_remains_open: A bounded same-lane search cannot establish absence, priority, or independent novelty. Symphony v2 was updated one day before this audit; 2026 literature requires a submission-date rerun and independent review.
required_manuscript_narrowing: Say bounded current searches did not locate a direct equivalent; never say first, unique, or proven novel.
Name the exact grammar/objective whenever support two is a headline.
Separate conditional logical Clifford count from T count, depth, physical qubits, and spacetime.
Cite Symphony v2, TARE v4, current block-encoding T-count work, and fault-tolerant benchmark/resource literature.
subtraction_summary.residual_candidate: A sharp all-n optimum-support threshold kappa_R6M=2 for the exactly frozen three-block shared-one-bit-Tag TARE-M2 grammar and declared (4,2,2,1) logical support-count objective, with exact support-one lower witness and weight-two obstruction.
